personality_one_liner: A vibrant, chunky, and tactile 2D open-city delivery simulator where every action feels like a colorful, interactive comic-book panel.

spacing.rule: Generous padding to make the UI feel chunky and touchable. Important controls (joystick, phone) get oversized tap areas and sit clearly in the thumb zone.

do's: Use on the in-game smartphone UI over the gameplay background
Use for floating HUD elements like the mini-map and stats container
dont's: Do not use on garage cards
Do not use on primary CTA buttons

screens.name: GarageScreen
screens.purpose: The starting hub where the player selects their bike and gear before heading out.

states.loading: Chunky spinning wheel icon in the center.
states.error: Failed to load garage data. Playful error icon with retry button.

screens.layout: Top 50% is a 2D environment (garage_interior image with gradient scrim at bottom). The selected scooter sits in the center of the image. The bottom 50% is a floating bottom-sheet-style card layout (`surfaceSecondary`, `lg` radius) containing horizontal scrolling shelves for Bikes and Gear. Selected items get a `borderStrong` highlight. A sticky 'HEAD OUT' primary CTA (`brandPrimary`, pill shape) anchors the bottom edge inside safe area.

screens.name: GameHUD
screens.purpose: The main playable area overlay containing directional controls, mini-map, in-game phone, and ad placeholders.

states.error: Connection lost. Retry button overlaid on frozen game state.

screens.layout: A full-bleed screen for the 2D world. HUD elements sit directly on top. Top-Left: Rounded-square Mini-GPS module with glass background. Top-Right: Stats pill (Earnings) and a chunky Online/Offline toggle. Bottom-Left: On-screen directional joystick (large semi-transparent circle with inner nub). Bottom-Right: Interact/Action buttons + 'Open Phone' button. Mid-screen: Integrated placeholders reading 'PLACE FOR ADS' painted on virtual building walls or hoardings as requested.

screens.name: InGamePhone
screens.purpose: A simulated smartphone interface where the player accepts orders, checks messages, and manages earnings.

states.empty: No active orders. Friendly illustration inside the phone screen.

screens.layout: Opens as an overlaid centered modal (or right-side panel) when triggered from the HUD. The phone container uses a heavy `borderStrong` outline or distinct `shadow 2` to feel like an object. Inside the phone: a grid of apps (Orders, GPS, Wallet). When an order arrives, a dynamic notification banner drops from the top of the phone screen with 'Accept' (`brandSecondary`) and 'Decline' (`brandTertiary`) buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile/Playful UI rules. Keep elements chunky, rounded (lg to pill), and use high contrast text on the warm background.
Borders (borderStrong) should be utilized sparsely but effectively to make UI elements pop, matching a comic-book aesthetic.
Implement the HUD controls (joystick, phone trigger, mini-map) using `react-native-gesture-handler` for smooth, responsive interactions.

For the 'PLACE FOR ADS', simply design visually distinct billboard/hoarding UI containers within the game world (using View blocks) labeled 'PLACE FOR ADS' with a contrasting background to stand out from the city textures.
Ensure the in-game phone modal doesn't cover the entire screen; it should look like a device overlaid on the gameplay (approx 80% height, 85% width on mobile).
Use Phosphor icons heavily (filled versions for active states, outlined for inactive) in the phone's grid and HUD elements.
For day-night/weather cycles, consider overlaying a full-screen pointer-events-none View with low-opacity dark/blue tint for night and warm/orange for day.
Haptics: Provide tactile feedback (ImpactFeedbackStyle.Light/Medium) on Joystick direction changes, button presses, and when the phone order modal drops down.
